quote: Cattaneo's seminal work on quasiperfect numbers, 'Sui numeri quasiperfetti,' was published in Bollettino dell'Unione Matematica Italiana, volume 6, pages 59-62 in 1951
note: Cattaneo's 1951 publication is the earliest documented work defining and studying quasiperfect numbers. He proved that if a quasiperfect number exists, it must be an odd perfect square.
